prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation atlas for a historical maritime RPG. Image 1 is the FULL-BODY costume and boots reference from the character's current street walk. Image 2 is the FACE AND HAIRSTYLE identity reference. Create a NEW sheet with the requested actions; preserve this exact adult person's face, hair, body proportions, costume colors, accessories, garment lengths and footwear. Detailed realistic hand-painted game illustration, consistent identity throughout, not chibi. All equipment secured at waist, any sword SHEATHED throughout; empty hands for movement and gestures. Props must remain attached to the belt or genuinely held by fingers. No floating props. Every full figure including hair, fingers, feet and cloth fits wholly inside its own equal-sized cell with generous clear gutters. No duplicate extra people, grid lines, borders, labels, lettering, ground shadows, floor or background gradients. The entire background outside every silhouette must be truly transparent with actual ALPHA ZERO, not white or gray partly-transparent haze. Do not crop heads, raised hands or boots. Do not change camera zoom or figure scale between frames. EXACTLY 8 full-body TURN-AWAY AND ENTER frames in a STRICT 4 columns x 2 rows grid, landscape 1536x1024. A single one-way progression, NOT a looping spin. Frame order: 1 relaxed RIGHT-facing profile; 2 slight turn away from viewer; 3 rear three-quarter view turned 45 degrees away; 4 rear three-quarter almost back view; 5 completely BACK-facing with left foot stepping; 6 completely BACK-facing with right foot passing; 7 completely BACK-facing opposite step; 8 completely BACK-facing standing with BOTH FEET planted. In frames 5 through 8 show only the back of the head: NO eyes, nose or front face. Preserve back of hairstyle, braid or tied hair and exact garment construction. The figure does NOT become smaller or move to the edge of a cell. No doorway, door, building, ground, props or perspective zoom: runtime adds the doorway and distance effect. Every full figure must be surrounded by generous transparent margins: maximum 78% of cell height, including raised hands.
